INSERT INTO n8n_delivery.receipts (idempotency_key,payload_hash,owner_token)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET idempotency_key=EXCLUDED.idempotency_key
RETURNING state,payload_hash,owner_token;
UPDATE n8n_delivery.receipts SET state='sent',sent_at=now() WHERE idempotency_key=$1 AND payload_hash=$2 AND owner_token=$3 AND state='processing' RETURNING state;
